recommendation.scope: Measured base scenarios only; not a universal optimum or clinical validation.
recommendation.criteria: All households assigned, no unmet listed needs/overflow/empty or full open sites; then lower no-car mean travel and all-household mean travel.

validation: 45 profile/scenario/seed cases compared, then 15 balanced cases rerun after solver bound improvements. All 3 final base runs proven OPTIMAL with zero repeat moves. Shortage/outage scenarios remain explicitly infeasible for capacity/medical requirements.
measured_tradeoff: Equal utilization increases overall travel versus packing the nearest fully supplied sites; in the nine-hub base sample it also reduces travel for households without cars.
comparison_note: Historical comparison profiles retain diagnostics from their source runs; only iteration-08 records use the final allocator fingerprint.
